task: Parse an AWS CloudWatch log entry and extract the timestamp, log level, and message using a regular expression
solution_criteria: Regex pattern must correctly capture timestamp (ISO 8601 format), log level (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG), and message content from a single log line

task: Create a JSON CloudFormation template snippet that defines an S3 bucket with versioning enabled and public read access blocked
solution_criteria: Valid JSON with correct CloudFormation resource syntax, S3 bucket properties including VersioningConfiguration, and BlockPublicAccess settings properly configured

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS IAM policy ARN string and returns the account ID and resource name extracted from it
solution_criteria: Function correctly parses ARN format (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:RESOURCE_TYPE/RESOURCE_NAME) and returns both account ID and resource identifier as a tuple or dictionary
